data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'sh-d-dh', meaning 'to be honorable' or 'to be respected'. This name is often given to girls who are believed to possess noble qualities and are deserving of respect. The name Mashoodah carries the meaning “Honored, Respected” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mashoodah usually hope their child will grow to embody honored, respected and live with faith, good character and purpose.
